How to playControls, gamepads and a few tricks

Choose how you play

←→ move · ↓ crouch Z throw · ↑+Z upward X jump · hold to leap higher C switch blade P / Esc pause and options M sound · Enter confirm

With a gamepad: D-pad or stick to move, A to jump, B/X to throw, RB to switch blades and Start to pause. On a touchscreen, use the D-pad and the BLADE and JUMP buttons.

One edge, endless possibilities

Choose your blade. The Crescent cuts through the whole group and strikes again on the way back. The Zephyr (world 4) reaches farther, hits two foes and flies over pillars. The Lightning (world 10) is blazing fast if you hold throw, but short: it returns on the first hit and only pierces bosses with fury.

Grow your power. Gems improve reach and damage. Look for urns up high and chain stomps to multiply your points.

Explore at your own pace. The atlas opens all twenty worlds for practice, and the time trial puts the ones you have reached to the test. The campaign keeps your gear, your record and three medals per world.
